passage.label: Lord heavens earth whatever between Most Merciful not possess authority speech; Day Spirit angels stand row not speak except one Most Merciful permits said correct; True Day whoever wills take Lord way return; Indeed warned impending punishment Day man observe hands put forth disbeliever say Oh wish were dust

arabicExcerpts.text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا

mainSubject.label: The Lord of heavens, earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful, before whom none possesses authority for speech; on that Day the Spirit and angels stand in rows and none speaks except one permitted by the Most Merciful who has spoken correctly; this is the True Day so whoever wills should take a way of return to his Lord; the warning of impending punishment on the Day when a man observes what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever wishes he were dust

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the agricultural-produce catalogue (16) before the Day-of-Judgement appointment opens (17); P2 ends with the no-increase-except-torment verdict (30) before the righteous-attainment block begins (31); P3 covers the six-verse reward description (31-36); P4 runs through divine sovereignty, angelic rows, the True Day and the closing dust-wish (37-40).
